bug.name: Bug
bug.note: Self-repairs fast; cannot carry human-built armor.

human.name: Human
human.note: High energy, no self-repair until bug armor is installed (light repair only).

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.note: Self-repairs slowly without energy; can use armor.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.note: One-man fighter: high agility, small racks.

frigate.name: Frigate
frigate.note: Medium agility; bigger racks, more damage taken and dealt.

warship.name: Warship
warship.note: Low agility; heavy racks. Hard to evade in.
